name: American Cheese
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated as it's aged/processed and lower in lactose than fresh dairy. Monitor individual tolerance.
preparationTips: Choose brands without added onion or garlic powder
Check labels for high-FODMAP additives like inulin
Melts well for grilled cheese and quesadillas
Store properly refrigerated and use within expiration date
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of calcium for bone health
